details: Batch for Sun Nov 22 sent, waiting for approval
summary: 24 of the 35 Trial Reels from the last 7 days are counted; the other 11 show 0 or 1 views and are left out. The counted reels drew 7,619 views in total, typically about 275 each. The typical 3-second hold is 16.2 percent, down from 21.5 percent the week before (19.6 percent against 25.3 percent when weighted by views). Block 3 was called this morning: O4, the author or explainer line, held 19.0 percent on 971 views against 17.6 percent on 594 for O1, the number fact line, a gap of 1.4 points, which counts as a tie. The new block has no numbers yet. Best recent reel by hold: Sharh Kashf ash-Shubuhat on Nov 15 at 24.9 percent. Worst: Sharh Kashf ash-Shubuhat on Nov 17 at 8.1 percent. All 11 uncounted reels were books that had already run on an earlier day, and 4 of yesterday's 5 are among them, so repeated books look like the cause, though that cannot be confirmed from the numbers. Today's batch tests O1, a count taken from the book, against O5, the edition fact line (language, binding, publisher), on five books that did not run in the last three days.
change: Block 3 was called: the champion stayed. O4, the author or explainer line, held 19.0 percent on 971 views against 17.6 percent on 594 for O1, the number fact line. O4 was 1.4 points ahead, under the 8 points needed to win, so it is a tie and nothing in the formula changes. The call is rechecked on Tue Nov 24. The next block, starting today, tests O5, the edition fact line showing language, binding and publisher over the book in the first second. No schedule change.
